data.summary: A differential probe of 600 same-input cases found 84 differences. FakeFs.copy_file onto a directory writes a file at the directory path (real: copies into it); copy_file and move to a missing parent succeed (real: FileNotFoundError); replace_path of a directory raises FileNotFoundError (real: renames) and replace_path of a file over a directory succeeds (real: IsADirectoryError); copy_file onto itself is silent (real: SameFileError); move(x, x) raises ValueError (real: no-op). Test-only: FakeFs has no production caller. Fix before AU-fs-sweep tests rely on it.

data.summary: `ddflow bug fixed B-modularity-guard-substring-family --regression-test ... --mutation-file ...` ran from the ADP-fs worktree that holds the fix and closed the bug as [could-not-run]: it looks only for the bug's own fix task's worktree. The mutation given was never applied, though the tree to apply it to was the current one. The bug closes unverified, and the fix task stays open. It should verify in the current worktree or the item that carries the fix.
data.title: bug fixed cannot verify a fix made on another item's branch

data.body:
Fixes bug B-bug-fixed-other-item-unverified: `ddflow bug fixed B-modularity-guard-substring-family --regression-test ... --mutation-file ...` ran from the ADP-fs worktree that holds the fix and closed the bug as [could-not-run]: it looks only for the bug's own fix task's worktree. The mutation given was never applied, though the tree to apply it to was the current one. The bug closes unverified, and the fix task stays open. It should verify in the current worktree or the item that carries the fix. Found on ADP-fs.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B-bug-fixed-other-item-unverified --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B-bug-fixed-other-item-unverified --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug B-bug-fixed-other-item-unverified: bug fixed cannot verify a fix made on another item's branch
